title: Claude Code - Extensions & Agents
description: Subagent & effort cost attribution (AMP), MCP server/tool analytics and Plugin/Skill adoption (Athena). AMP panels reflect all history; Athena panels populate from the 2.x schema deploy onward.

list.name: user
list.label: User (Athena)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(user_name, user_id) AS user_display FROM claude_code_telemetry.events WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND "timestamp" BETWEEN from_iso8601_timestamp('${__from:date:iso}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp('${__to:date:iso}') ORDER BY user_display

panels.title: Cost by Subagent
panels.description: Cumulative cost attributed to each subagent (agent_name label). Empty label = main thread.

panels.title: Cost by Effort Mode
panels.description: Cost split across effort modes (e.g. high, xhigh).

panels.title: Token Rate by Effort Mode
panels.description: Token consumption rate per effort mode.

panels.title: Subagent Activity Detail (Athena)
panels.description: Per-subagent API call count, cost, and avg latency. Populates from 2.x deploy onward.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT COALESCE(agent_name, '(main thread)') AS agent, COUNT(*) AS api_calls, ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 4) AS total_cost, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 0) AS avg_latency_ms, COALESCE(effort, '-') AS effort FROM claude_code_telemetry.events WHERE event_name = 'claude_code.api_request' AND "timestamp" BETWEEN from_iso8601_timestamp('${__from:date:iso}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp('${__to:date:iso}') AND (COALESCE(user_name, user_id) LIKE '${user}' OR '${user}' = '%') GROUP BY agent_name, effort ORDER BY total_cost DESC

panels.title: Subagent Completion Summary (Athena)
panels.description: Per subagent_type: runs, avg duration, avg tokens, avg tool uses. From the subagent_completed event; populates from 2.x deploy onward.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT COALESCE(agent_type, '(unknown)') AS agent_type, MAX(agent_source) AS source, COUNT(*) AS runs, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 0) AS avg_duration_ms, CAST(ROUND(AVG(total_tokens), 0) AS BIGINT) AS avg_tokens, ROUND(AVG(total_tool_uses), 1) AS avg_tool_uses FROM claude_code_telemetry.events WHERE event_name = 'claude_code.subagent_completed' AND "timestamp" BETWEEN from_iso8601_timestamp('${__from:date:iso}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp('${__to:date:iso}') AND (COALESCE(user_name, user_id) LIKE '${user}' OR '${user}' = '%') GROUP BY agent_type ORDER BY runs DESC

panels.title: MCP Connection Success Rate
panels.description: Share of mcp_server_connection events with status='connected'.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN mcp_status = 'connected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS success_pct FROM claude_code_telemetry.events WHERE event_name = 'claude_code.mcp_server_connection' AND "timestamp" BETWEEN from_iso8601_timestamp('${__from:date:iso}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp('${__to:date:iso}')

panels.title: MCP Server Connections
panels.description: Per MCP server: connection attempts, success, avg connect time, transport.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT COALESCE(plugin_name, '(standalone)') AS server, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN mcp_status='connected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS connected, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 0) AS avg_connect_ms, MAX(transport_type) AS transport, MAX(server_scope) AS scope FROM claude_code_telemetry.events WHERE event_name = 'claude_code.mcp_server_connection' AND "timestamp" BETWEEN from_iso8601_timestamp('${__from:date:iso}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp('${__to:date:iso}') GROUP BY plugin_name ORDER BY attempts DESC

panels.title: MCP Tool Usage (cost)
panels.description: Cost attributed to MCP tools via the mcp_tool_name label.

panels.title: Skill Activation Frequency
panels.description: How often each skill is activated (skill_name label). Empty = main thread, excluded.

panels.title: Plugins Loaded by Marketplace
panels.description: Distinct plugins loaded, grouped by marketplace. Populates from 2.x deploy onward.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT COALESCE(marketplace_name, '(local)') AS marketplace, COUNT(DISTINCT plugin_name) AS plugins FROM claude_code_telemetry.events WHERE event_name = 'claude_code.plugin_loaded' AND "timestamp" BETWEEN from_iso8601_timestamp('${__from:date:iso}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp('${__to:date:iso}') GROUP BY marketplace_name ORDER BY plugins DESC

panels.title: Plugin Capability Matrix
panels.description: Per plugin: scope, version, whether it provides MCP/hooks. Populates from 2.x deploy onward.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT plugin_name, MAX(plugin_scope) AS scope, MAX(plugin_version) AS version, MAX(marketplace_name) AS marketplace, BOOL_OR(has_mcp) AS has_mcp, BOOL_OR(has_hooks) AS has_hooks, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions FROM claude_code_telemetry.events WHERE event_name = 'claude_code.plugin_loaded' AND "timestamp" BETWEEN from_iso8601_timestamp('${__from:date:iso}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp('${__to:date:iso}') GROUP BY plugin_name ORDER BY sessions DESC
